title: Platform section at rest: sweep and dash glint on the GPU (not pixel-identical: dash edge differs on iPhone WebKit)
problem: Not pixel-identical, first: on iPhone WebKit (Simulator) the grey dashes' bottom edge pixels differ by up to 17 of 255 the WHOLE TIME the glint is mounted, not only while it passes (first picture). The problem: at the bottom of the page (the #platform section) the page never rests. The colour sweep inside the four titles re-runs style every frame, and the glint on the dashed line repaints every frame. Pre-registered counts at rest (P-077), per 4 s sweep cycle: Chrome style 240 -> 8, paints about 481 -> 33; Simulator style about 478 -> 8, layouts about 237 -> 8, paints about 952 -> 4.
idea: Both effects move as GPU transforms of the same gradient: the sweep as a band behind a text-shaped mask, the glint as a gradient strip clipped to the dash's exact shape. Same timing, same 1 s start delay, same stop when scrolled away, reduced motion unchanged.
looksSame: Same colours, same speed, same shape and timing; the differences are sub-pixel edge and phase shades (numbers below), measured on frozen frames at the same moment.
risk: Pixel rule exception needed (look-alike). The dash-edge shade on WebKit is permanent while the glint is mounted. Before landing, the lead runs one short phone no-worse check after your choice.

Colour sweep inside the titles: shifted by under a third of a device pixel; up to 9/255 on phones, 23/255 on a 1440 px desktop, 10/255 in WebKit

recommended.why: Only both together let the platform tail rest (style and paints near zero at the page bottom); each alone leaves the other redrawing every frame.

decision.notes:
It's interesting proposal, for the visual it looks like as the same. i'd like to ask you investigate more about the measurement of pixel-identical. how you measure them? and how much of diff % of both compare. 

I think we can use this proposal for add new rules for widen for optimization acceptable about pixel-identical diff. 

Can you open the new thread for catch up this? 
And you may have to improve the thread support image posting. i'm not the tool is ready to support this feature. 
And investigate more can we apply these technique on anther elements for better animation performance rendering.
